<style>
/* ===== Cyberpunk Cursor ===== */
html,body,a,button,input,textarea,select,[role='button'],label,.clickable {
  cursor: url('https://img.seedvault.cn/i/2026/08/23/d6f49097-9672-4f52-ac13-3d2d9ce9ba56_compressed6a8aa8926db6d187.png') 16 16, auto !important;
}
*::before,*::after { cursor: inherit !important; }

/* ===== Cyberpunk Canvas ===== */
#cyber-bg-canvas {
  position: fixed !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  left: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  z-index: -1 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

body { background: #0a0a14 !important; }
#header,#content,#footer { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.SideNav { background: rgba(10,10,30,0.85) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,255,0.2) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0,255,255,0.08) !important; }
.SideNav-item:hover { background: rgba(0,255,255,0.08) !important; border-left: 3px solid #00ffff !important; }
#header { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,255,255,0.3) !important; box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(0,255,255,0.1) !important; }
.title-left a { background: linear-gradient(90deg,#ff00ff,#00ffff,#ff00ff) !important; background-size: 200% auto !important; -webkit-background-clip: text !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent !important; background-clip: text !important; animation: cyber-gradient 3s linear infinite !important; }
@keyframes cyber-gradient { to { background-position: 200% center; } }
.avatar { border: 2px solid #00ffff !important; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0,255,255,0.4),0 0 30px rgba(255,0,255,0.2) !important; }
.avatar:hover { border-color: #ff00ff !important; box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(255,0,255,0.5),0 0 50px rgba(0,255,255,0.3) !important; }
.Label { border: 1px solid rgba(255,0,255,0.4) !important; text-shadow: 0 0 6px currentColor !important; }
.markdown-body a,.SideNav-item a { color: #ff00ff !important; text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,0,255,0.3); }
.markdown-body a:hover { color: #00ffff !important; text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0,255,255,0.5); }
.markdown-body { background: rgba(10,10,30,0.85) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,255,0.15) !important; color: #d0d0e8 !important; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,255,255,0.06) !important; }
.markdown-body h1,.markdown-body h2,.markdown-body h3 { color: #00ffff !important; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,255,255,0.2) !important; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0,255,255,0.3); }
.markdown-body code { background: rgba(0,255,255,0.1) !important; color: #00ffff !important; border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,255,0.2); }
.markdown-body pre code { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6) !important; color: #b0b0d0 !important; border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,255,0.15); }
.markdown-body blockquote { border-left: 4px solid #ff00ff !important; background: rgba(255,0,255,0.05) !important; color: #c0c0e0 !important; }
.markdown-body hr { border: none !important; height: 1px !important; background: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#00ffff,#ff00ff,transparent) !important; }
.subnav-search-input { background: rgba(10,10,30,0.8) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,255,0.3) !important; color: #d0d0e8 !important; }
.subnav-search-input:focus { border-color: #00ffff !important; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0,255,255,0.2) !important; }
.subnav-search button { background: linear-gradient(135deg,#ff00ff,#00ffff) !important; color: #000 !important; border: none !important; }
#footer { color: rgba(160,160,200,0.6) !important; }
#footer a { color: #00ffff !important; }
#cmButton { background: linear-gradient(135deg,#ff00ff,#00ffff) !important; color: #000 !important; }
.subnav { background: rgba(10,10,30,0.85) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,255,0.15) !important; }
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #0a0a14; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #00ffff; border-radius: 3px; }
</style>
<script>
(function(){
var c=document.createElement('canvas');c.id='cyber-bg-canvas';document.body.insertBefore(c,document.body.firstChild);
var ctx=c.getContext('2d'),W,H;
function resize(){W=c.width=window.innerWidth;H=c.height=window.innerHeight;}
resize();window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
var fs=14,cols=Math.floor(W/fs),drops=new Array(cols).fill(1);
var chars='アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソタチツテトナニヌネノハヒフヘホマミムメモヤユヨラリルレロワヲン0123456789ABCDEF';
var pts=[];for(var i=0;i<35;i++)pts.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.4,vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.4,s:Math.random()*2+1,a:Math.random()*0.4+0.1});
var scanY=0;
function draw(){
ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,10,20,0.06)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,255,255,0.12)';ctx.font=fs+'px monospace';
for(var i=0;i<drops.length;i++){ctx.fillText(chars[Math.floor(Math.random()*chars.length)],i*fs,drops[i]*fs);if(drops[i]*fs>H&&Math.random()>0.975)drops[i]=0;drops[i]++;}
ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,255,255,0.03)';ctx.lineWidth=0.5;
for(var x=0;x<W;x+=60){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,H);ctx.stroke();}
for(var y=0;y<H;y+=60){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(W,y);ctx.stroke();}
for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i++){var p=pts[i];p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;if(p.x<0)p.x=W;if(p.x>W)p.x=0;if(p.y<0)p.y=H;if(p.y>H)p.y=0;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.s,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,0,255,'+p.a+')';ctx.fill();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.s*3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,0,255,'+(p.a*0.15)+')';ctx.fill();}
for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i++){for(var j=i+1;j<pts.length;j++){var dx=pts[i].x-pts[j].x,dy=pts[i].y-pts[j].y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);if(d<130){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pts[i].x,pts[i].y);ctx.lineTo(pts[j].x,pts[j].y);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,0,255,'+(0.08*(1-d/130))+')';ctx.lineWidth=0.5;ctx.stroke();}}}
if(H>0){scanY=(scanY+1.2)%H;var y1=Math.max(0,scanY-25),y2=Math.min(H,scanY+25);if(y2>y1){var g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,y1,0,y2);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,255,255,0)');g.addColorStop(0.5,'rgba(0,255,255,0.025)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,255,255,0)');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,y1,W,y2-y1);}}
requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}
draw();
})();
</script>
